name: letter-slot-machine
title: Letter Slot Machine
description: Each letter is a clipped vertical reel of the full alphabet; changing the value spins every reel through a different number of stops, so the word resolves left-to-right like a payline landing.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Value Change Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
